fusions.name: Hamstring Snap
fusions.desc: A low cut that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Trail's End
fusions.desc: Runs down a target up to 6 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Silent at Heel
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 11%. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Other Set of Teeth
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
